mentions.name: Maqet
mentions.description: Web-based CAD software for woodworkers, built from scratch. It aims to be intuitive for non-technical users (like SketchUp) while offering more powerful CAD tools tailored to woodworking, including simple parametric workflows, cutting layout optimization, and built-in tools such as chamfers and joints.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building web-based CAD software for woodworkers. Not a plugin, I'm starting from scratch. I'm aiming for it to be intuitive for non-technical users (think SketchUp), while also offering some of the more powerful tools of "proper" CAD tailored for woodworking: simple parametric workflows, cutting layout optimization, built-in tools like chamfers and joints,...
